note: Recorded evidence from the WP6c paid probes on 2026-08-13. Every episode, reward, runtime record and resolved configuration here was produced by a real Verifiers evaluation of a real subject model in a real Docker runtime. Nothing is invented.

reprojection.campaign_and_manifest: campaign.json and experiment.json are Techtree's own staged documents, re-issued by the ordinary builders over the Campaign this build now derives, which the probes' Campaign was byte-identical to before the release regeneration moved the subject image pin and the taskset validation receipt. Only the mounted Skill is carried across from the recorded configuration. Every derived digest -- configuration_digest, the manifest id, campaign_spec_digest, experiment_manifest_digest in execution.json, and this variant's own manifest digest in request.json -- was recomputed from the re-issued documents.
reprojection.cross_variant_manifest_digest: request.json's other-variant manifest digest still names the historical document. Each probe is a separate run and only its own variant's manifest was ever committed here, so the other one cannot be recomputed.
reprojection.image_index_digest: Parsed from the runtime reference the trace already recorded, by the same rule the current normalizer applies.
reprojection.model_calls: NOT a measurement. The projection that wrote this evidence recorded no per-trace call list, and the raw traces that held one are gone, so each trace carries its own recorded num_turns in this field as the closest count the recording can account for. It is a lower bound on the real figure, nothing asserts on it, and re-recording these probes replaces it with the measured count.
reprojection.sampling: Read from this variant's own config.toml, which is the engine's resolved settings for this run, unmodified.
reprojection.subject_platform: Derived, not recorded: the probes ran on the darwin/arm64 workstation that produced this fixture, so the daemon served the pinned index as linux/arm64.
reprojection.usage_cost_usd: Recorded as null. The provider reported no cost for these probes, which is why the original projection carried no cost field.
reprojection.why: Decisions document 0007 R5 and R9 changed shapes these probes predate: a Campaign pins its subject container per platform, a normalized trace carries the sampling settings it ran under and the number of model calls it made, and a normalized runtime carries the image index digest its reference names rather than a digest-and-source pair. The probes' raw traces were never retained (raw_traces_retained is false above), so the projection could not be recomputed from its source and was re-projected in place instead.
